canonical_name: Local class field theory for nonarchimedean local fields
canonical_statement: For a nonarchimedean local field K, finite abelian extensions L/K correspond to open finite-index subgroups of K^times via L mapping to the norm subgroup N_{L/K}(L^times); equivalently, for each finite abelian L/K the local reciprocity homomorphism K^times -> Gal(L/K) is surjective with kernel N_{L/K}(L^times), subject to a fixed reciprocity normalization.
domain_and_universes: K is a nonarchimedean local field; L/K ranges over finite abelian extensions; exact characteristic scope, Lean universes, topology, and extension equivalence relation remain to be frozen at the statement phase
quantifiers: for every eligible nonarchimedean local field K
for every finite abelian extension L/K
for every open finite-index subgroup U of K^times
hypotheses: K is a nonarchimedean local field
L/K is finite, Galois, and has abelian Galois group
U is open and of finite index in K^times
conclusion: Local reciprocity identifies K^times/N_{L/K}(L^times) with Gal(L/K), and norm subgroups classify finite abelian extensions, with inclusion/reversal and normalization data made explicit.
excluded_degenerate_cases: Archimedean fields and nonabelian extensions are excluded. The trivial extension and subgroup K^times are included. Whether equal-characteristic local fields are included is deliberately unresolved rather than silently inferred from the terse source phrase.
